intervention.supporting_evidence: The results demonstrate that SFPQ overexpression improves recognition and memory in AD mice, while reducing AD-related marker proteins such as amyloid precursor protein (APP) and Tau. Additionally, synaptic and memory-associated proteins, as well as antioxidant proteins like glutathione S-transferase (GST) and heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), were upregulated. The ratio of antiapoptotic protein Bcl-2 to proapoptotic protein Bax also increased.
